response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong alignment with the Staff Software Engineer role, particularly in distributed systems, AI-driven development, and technical strategy. His current work at re:cinq on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators is highly relevant, and his experience with high-throughput systems at Sociomantic and operational ownership at multiple companies further strengthens his candidacy. While his background is broad, his recent focus on AI-native environments and full-stack engineering makes him a strong fit.
strengths: Direct experience with AI-driven engineering (re:cinq, MCP code generators, agentic workflows).
Proven expertise in distributed, high-throughput systems (Sociomantic, Dunnhumby).
Full-stack versatility with TypeScript/Python and operational ownership (on-call, CI/CD, monitoring).
concerns: Breadth of experience may dilute depth in some areas (e.g., LLM/ML hands-on work).
Limited explicit evidence of stakeholder management at scale (e.g., cross-functional leadership).
Recent roles emphasize execution over documented technical strategy ownership.
